cases.name: two-push-urls-disagreeing
cases.stderr:
error  remote 'origin' pushes to two different repositories, 'o/r' and 'o/other'
       git pushes to every `remote.origin.pushurl` entry, and CrossRev pushes only to the head repository of the pull request under review. Remove the entry that does not belong.

cases.name: non-github-url-refuses
cases.stderr:
error  remote 'origin' pushes to 'https://gitlab.com/o/r.git', which is not a github.com repository URL
       CrossRev checks where a fix will land before it leaves the machine, and it can only do that for a github.com URL. Check `git config --get-all remote.origin.pushurl`.
